# pltr resource-role

Resource role operations using foundry-platform-sdk.

Grant, revoke and list the roles users and groups have on a filesystem resource (a project, folder, dataset, ...). Resources are addressed by RID; principals by their user or group ID (a UUID), never by name. Role IDs come from the role set of the resource's space.

Examples:

        # List the role grants on a dataset
        pltr resource-role list ri.foundry.main.dataset.xyz123
        # Include inherited roles, as JSON
        pltr resource-role list ri.foundry.main.dataset.xyz123 \
            --include-inherited --format json
        # Grant a role to a user or group (by ID)
        pltr resource-role grant ri.compass.main.folder.abc456 \
            --principal-id 6f2a1b3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 --role compass:manage
        # Revoke it (asks for confirmation; --yes skips it)
        pltr resource-role revoke ri.compass.main.folder.abc456 \
            --principal-id 6f2a1b3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 --role compass:manage

3 commands. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

### pltr resource-role grant

Grant a role on a resource to a user, a group or everyone.

`pltr resource-role grant RESOURCE_RID --role TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `RESOURCE_RID` (RID or path): RID of the resource: a project, folder, dataset or any other filesystem resource (ri.<service>.<instance>.<type>.<id>).
- `--role`, `-r` TEXT (required): Role ID, from the role set of the resource's space (for example compass:manage for Owner in the default role set).
- `--principal-id`, `-p` TEXT: ID of the user or group (a UUID; usernames and group names are not accepted).
- `--everyone`: Use the Everyone principal instead of an ID.
- SDK: `filesystem.Resource.Role.add`

### pltr resource-role list

List the role grants on a resource.

`pltr resource-role list RESOURCE_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `RESOURCE_RID` (RID or path): RID of the resource: a project, folder, dataset or any other filesystem resource (ri.<service>.<instance>.<type>.<id>).
- `--principal-type`, `-t` USER|GROUP|EVERYONE: Only show grants to users, groups or everyone.
- `--include-inherited`: Also list the roles the resource inherits from its parents.
- paged · SDK: `filesystem.Resource.Role.list`

### pltr resource-role revoke

Revoke a role on a resource from a user, a group or everyone.

`pltr resource-role revoke RESOURCE_RID --role TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `RESOURCE_RID` (RID or path): RID of the resource: a project, folder, dataset or any other filesystem resource (ri.<service>.<instance>.<type>.<id>).
- `--role`, `-r` TEXT (required): Role ID, from the role set of the resource's space (for example compass:manage for Owner in the default role set).
- `--principal-id`, `-p` TEXT: ID of the user or group (a UUID; usernames and group names are not accepted).
- `--everyone`: Use the Everyone principal instead of an ID.
- **destructive** (asks first; `--yes` skips) · SDK: `filesystem.Resource.Role.remove`
